items.title: 9.2.3 Using Digital Tools to Create a Business Plan (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Using Digital Tools to Create a Business Plan' (PDF 211), rewritten 2026-10-27 to follow the book paragraph for paragraph.

blocks.text: Business plan banana kisi naye karobar (venture) ko shuru karne aur kamyabi se chalane ka bohat aham qadam hai. Aaj kal digital tools ne yeh kaam aasan aur tez (efficient) bana diya hai, aur in se plan comprehensive (poora, har zaroori baat wala) bhi banta hai aur professional bhi. Aage hum woh software dekhenge jo business plan banane mein madad deta hai, aur collaborative tools (mil kar kaam karne ke tools) jo teamwork aasan banate hain.

blocks.prompt: Business plan banane ke liye digital tools ki do qismein bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Business plan software aur collaborative tools.

items: Digital tools: plan likhne ka software aur collaborative tools.
